title: Aureline M5 stable-line protection plan
description: Canonical per-domain first-30-day protection plan minted by the first implement lane over the frozen M5 stable-line-protection matrix. Names the protected journey a supported line guards after stable — crash recovery, rollback / update, support export, migration / import, or another named launch-bearing flow — and binds its queued-regression issue IDs, release line, correction packet, rollback target, and delayed-breadth ledger so a supported line can prove which protected journeys are guarded, which regressions are queued for correction, and which breadth work is intentionally delayed while those regressions remain open, keeping every delayed-breadth claim bound to a recorded override or claim-narrowing action rather than to hand-edited prose. Downstream shiproom, release-center, executive-steering, program-governance, help, and support surfaces point at this schema instead of restating a line's first-30-day protection posture by hand. Raw secret values and private endpoints never cross this boundary.
